## The eval set, the markup and the runner's report

**R95. The eval protocol says how a sample is marked up, what lies in an eval set and what the runner gives: [the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), sections 11, 13 and 14. The markup is the field `markup` of a sample: the slot truth — the observation that one who reads right would give, the notes of the answer slots, and on a sheet the parts of the solution with the first error and the final answer, or the people's marks of an essay. A module's eval set is each `.json` under its `eval/`, and the runner rejects a sample whose task is not the one. The runner's report is the message `Report` without the content of the works, the text computes the measures from its records, and only a report with the verdicts of `module-kit` is fit for admission.** The author's answers of 2026-11-03 in planning T60 (RUN.md): of nine, eight by the recommendations of the plan, and the cut of the task not. The rest is a proposal of the plan that the author approved. Normative — [the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), sections 11, 13 and 14.
- **The markup** ([the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 11):
  - the field `markup` of the message `Sample`. Every writer writes it — the samples page and the code of the synthetic data —, and a file without it stays a sample: the runner does not measure it but rejects it. Who marks it up follows from the origin and "who wrote", and the file has no field of its own for it: an adult — themselves, by what the page showed; for a child — an adult, from the child's words, after the writing; the synthetic data — the code. The markup is made before saving, and after that it does not change, but for the marks of an essay;
  - the truth is the message `Observation` (R86): each answer slot that AI reads, with its value as written or the reason "unreadable", without a box. On a workbook — each box, and an empty one is `UNREADABLE_BLANK`. The runner derives the outcome and the trap as a verdict by the truth and the task's key, and they are not written into the markup;
  - the notes of the answer slots — a mirrored digit, whose truth is then `UNREADABLE_AMBIGUOUS`, and something crossed out: by them the rows of R56 and product 10 are measured apart;
  - on a sheet — one of two. Either the parts of the solution in the order of reading (В35 `tutor`; concepts 15), each with its kind, a text or a drawing, the text as written or the drawing in words, its strokes, "crossed out", "illegible on purpose" and "final answer", and the number of the part with the first error. Or the people's marks of an essay: whether a criterion is met, by its place in the rubric — what the people agreed on, and a criterion without agreement goes without a mark. The marks are added by the organizer of the eval set or of the measurement, when the people have agreed, before the set or the run; how many people assess and how they agree is decided by the volunteer's form, epic E4 (П-16);
  - the sample check holds what can be seen without the task: the places of the truth, the empty boxes, each visible stroke in one part, the first error, the final answer against the truth, the marks. What needs the task — whether the observation is fit, the answer slot `anywhere`, the criteria of the rubric — the runner holds.
- **Eval sets** ([the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 13):
  - a module's set is each file under `eval/` at any depth whose name ends in `.json`, but for files and folders beginning with `.`; other files are not samples. The format's layout `eval/<path>` does not change, and the format gets no new version. Whether to lay them flat is for `modules` to decide;
  - each sample of a module's set is of the purpose "eval set", with markup, on a task of its own module, and IDs in the set do not repeat;
  - the runner takes the task from the package of the module checked by its ID and seed, and the digest of the open view must match, while the tag, the version and the package digest in the reference are not compared;
  - a sample that is not valid or does not fit its task, without markup, with another's task or a child's, the runner rejects, and the run of the module's set does not pass. A pull request that changes the open view of a task redoes or removes its samples in the same pull request;
  - an AI capability's set is in `tutor` (R15): samples of any purpose, and the samples of a measurement and of a child are outside git (П-10, П-18). Capabilities whose input is not a sample have sets of their own form, in `tutor` too.
- **The runner's report** ([the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 14):
  - the message `Report`, one JSON per run, read strictly and written as canonical text, like a sample file. It holds no values, text, strokes or crops — only the IDs of the samples, places, verdicts and marks. The run's log, Markdown, CSV, bounds and thresholds stay with `tutor`;
  - the capability is an enumeration of the protocol: reading of handwriting or assessment by a rubric along the whole route. Other capabilities the protocol does not measure yet, and a new one will come as a new value — an addition;
  - the model — the provider and the model, as the list of admitted ones names it, with its setting; the verdict code — `module-kit` or the runner's own code, with its tag;
  - per sample — a refusal with its cause, or a measurement. For reading — the answer slots the model reads (on a workbook, the filled boxes), the verdict by the truth, the notes, and the verdict of each repetition, and for "unchecked" the cause: a failure, a limit or an unfit observation. For assessment — the people's marks and the outcome of each repetition: an assessment with the AI's marks, "unreadable" or "unchecked";
  - the report holds no totals. The measures — false alarm, false "correct", superfluous "unreadable", "unreadable" kept, the wrong trap, "unchecked", and the same apart on the mirrored and the crossed out, and for a rubric the false alarm on the met criteria, agreement and Cohen's kappa by criterion — the text computes from the records, and anyone can recompute them;
  - only a report with the verdicts of `module-kit` is fit for admission (the 2026-11-03 amendment to R07). Bounds, thresholds and repetitions are `tutor`'s admission rule;
  - a run at a provider and the publication of a report are by the provider's terms, and an open CI log is a publication too (R65). A report with the IDs of samples of a measurement or of a child is not published.
- **The check** — `tools/contracts/sample.mjs` holds the markup, and the new `tools/contracts/report.mjs` the report, by the same strict reading. An example of a report is `report-<case>.json`, and the check matches it with the samples beside it. `spec` computes no measures, and there are no vectors of the measures: one implementation computes them — `tutor`'s runner.
- **The examples** — five samples with markup and two reports, all synthetic data. The three earlier ones got markup by what their crops show. The two new ones — a sheet of free notation with a number line, and an essay — were drawn by the synthetic data of `tutor` v0.1.1, their groups and the numbers of their crops came from the implementation of the rules in `spec`, and the pixels from the code of `canvas` 602945b. No runner made the reports: their runner and verdict code are `v0.0.0`, and the models are stubs `example`.

- one task — the author's answer, not by the recommendation: the plan proposed to move the measures and the report to T74;
- a field of the sample — the author's answer by the recommendation: concepts 15 and [the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 11, already said that the markup lies in the file, and one file per sample the organizer checks as a whole;
- the truth as an observation — the author's answer by the recommendation: the runner compares an answer slot with an answer slot (R86), and a verdict by the truth and the key does not drift from the key when the module corrects the key;
- each `.json` under `eval/` — the author's answer by the recommendation: the format already lets in `eval/<path>`, and a layout rule would be format 0.3, T69, and would narrow the ID of a sample;
- the report as a message — the author's answer by the recommendation: CI of `modules` and `tutor`'s admission rule read it, and a format that `tutor` changes by itself would hold CI of `modules` to its version;

## The AI admission table

**R96. Admission to AI by age category is the admission table, a normative part of `spec` in `admission/`: the table, its JSON Schema schema, the text and test vectors, with its own version MAJOR.MINOR, the release file `admission-<version>.tar.gz`, `spec.Admission` in the Go module and the types `admissionv0` for Go and TypeScript. The table has two parts — the rule of an AI capability for an age category, and the cell "provider × AI route × category": closed, open, or open under deployment facts —, and what the table does not name is closed. Minimal retention is a fact of admission in all cells of platform AI, for adults too. For minors, the cells of platform AI are opened also by the fact of measures, which the operator declares only after the lawyer's answer, and the own key is open to `adult` alone. The admission function gets neither a region nor a country. A new version of the table opens a line of `spec`, and only `spec` changes a cell, on a signal.** Т-20 is closed. The author's answers of 2026-11-03 in planning T61 (RUN.md): of eight, six by the recommendations of the plan, and the scope of the task and the types not. The rest is a proposal of the plan that the author approved. Normative — [the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md).
- **What lies there** ([the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md), sections 3 and 4):
  - `admission/admission-table.json` — the providers by code, `openai`, `anthropic` and `google`; the dictionary of deployment facts; the rule of each AI capability for each category — `handwriting_reading`, `text_reading`, `solution_analysis`, `rubric_assessment`, `hint` and `voice`; the cells — `closed`, `open` or `open_with_facts`. A cell has the row of privacy 5.3 and the date read, `terms`, and what it rests on, `basis`;
  - the AI route is `platform_ai` and `own_key`: the glossary's terms "platform AI" and "own key" in snake_case, as R45 prescribes, and not `platform` from the recommendation of Т-20;
  - the table is JSON: code reads it. The schemas keep the format's conventions (R45) under their own prefix of `$id` and without `x-open`, and the codes of the categories are the same as the format's (R46). The examples and the vectors are YAML by the format's rules.
- **The cells** — by privacy 5.1 and 5.3, checked anew 2026-11-03:

  | Provider and route | `adult` | `from_consent_to_18` | `from_13_to_consent` and `under_13` |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Google, both routes | closed (R47) | closed | closed |
  | OpenAI, platform AI | DPA and minimal retention | plus measures for minors | plus zero data retention |
  | OpenAI, own key | open (О-4) | closed (П-4) | closed (П-4) |
  | Anthropic, platform AI | DPA and minimal retention | plus measures for minors | the same as `from_consent_to_18` |
  | Anthropic, own key | open (О-4) | closed (П-4) | closed (П-4) |

  There are no other providers in the table, and they are closed (R65). Voice is `adult` only (privacy 6; О-6), the other capabilities are open to all categories (privacy 3.2).
- **The deployment facts** ([the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md), section 5) — `data_processing_agreement`, `minimal_retention`, `zero_data_retention` and `minor_safeguards`. A fact holds at a provider for the categories the operator names: a DPA may not cover children's data, and zero data retention may be approved for one project. Minimal retention and zero data retention hold only if they hold for each model of the provider on the list of admitted ones. Zero data retention for audio will come with children's voice. The facts file and its parsing are in `tutor` and `api` (R57 tutor).
- **The admission function** ([the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md), section 6) checks by the table thus: the capability's rule, then the cell, then its facts in its order. A refusal is `capability_closed`, `cell_closed` or `fact_missing` with the fact, and the answer carries the table's version and the cell. The model is the fourth step, in `tutor` (R07). A vector of answers carries its own table, so a correction of a cell does not touch the vectors.
- **The version** ([the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md), section 2) — MAJOR.MINOR in `admission/VERSION`, from 0.1. Any correction of `admission-table.json` is a new version: a minor one if the form is the same, and a new input of the function, a refusal reason or a rule — a major one. A new version raises `RELEASE_LINE`, and `release-version` refuses otherwise (`tools/release/admission-line.mjs`), as R44 does for the format; it does not let through a correction of `admission-table.json` without a new version either. The table is not tied to the major version of `spec`, and the types package `admissionv0` holds only the major version 0: another will get its own package. 0.1 comes out with v0.8.0.
- **How a cell changes** ([the text of the admission table](../admission/README.md), section 10) — only in `spec`, by a pull request. The signal is a row «в реестр spec», most often of `tutor`, which calls the providers, or a check by `spec` itself before a decision on an AI route. The pull request checks the provider's row of privacy 5.3 anew in full, with the quote and the date, changes the cells and the dates, gives the table a new version in a new line and writes an amendment to R96 or a decision of its own. The operator can urgently close platform AI by themselves, by withdrawing a fact. The own key has no facts, and only a new version closes it.
- **The part's way** — as for the format (R64): `admission-<version>.tar.gz` in a release from line 0.8, with a cosign signature and under attestation; `spec.Admission` in the Go module; the types — the package `types/admissionv0` and the export `./admissionv0` of the package `@altnovatrail/spec` from line 0.8 (R72, R73). `release-verify` ties the file to a tag by the commit in the archive's header (R77). The check is `just admission-check`, the CI step "Admission table".

— *Why:*
- minimal retention as a fact — the author's answer by the recommendation of П-3: a DPA and zero data retention or exclusion from the abuse logs — before the first learners' data, adults' too. This does not hinder the first app: it goes by its own key (R76);
- without a region — the author's answer by the recommendation: the region is chosen once, before the first deployment (П-11), and the slice does not accept learners from the EU and the UK before the DPIA (П-2). The option "by learner" of П-11 would give the function an input, and that is a major version of the table;
- without a country — the author's answer by the recommendation: age verification is a measure for minors, and the operator will not declare the fact of measures before the lawyer's answer on П-6, while for the providers' rules about age the category is enough (R06);
- the fact of measures for minors — the author's answer by the recommendation, a proposal of `tutor` (R57 tutor). Platform AI is closed to children until the lawyer's answer, and the deployment configuration opens it, without a release of `spec`, and self-hosting decides with its own lawyer. This is not the option of П-15 "platform AI for under 18 — only at providers whose measures are met" as a product decision: that the measures are enough, the lawyer says, not the table;
- a version of its own that opens a line — the author's answer by the recommendation: in a line there is one table, the tag names it, and a refusal in the log says by which table it was given;
- only `spec` changes a cell — the author's answer by the recommendation: the rule about age does not leave the normative part for the code or the configuration of one component (R57 tutor), and the terms are checked "before each decision on an AI route" (privacy 5.3). There is no scheduled check by a deadline: a CI check that looked at the date would fail by itself, with time;
- one task — the author's answer, not by the recommendation;
- the types now — the author's answer, not by the recommendation.

— *Rejected:*
- minimal retention as settings of `tutor`'s calls and the provider's defaults, and zero data retention only where the terms require it;
- the region as a deployment fact: which region is fit is not decided yet;
- the country as an input of the function, a third part of the table "country × category";
- the cells of minors with a DPA and retention alone: AI would open to children before the lawyer's answer about monitoring; the cells of minors closed in the table itself until the lawyer: self-hosting with its own lawyer would not open them without a release of `spec`;
- a version of its own with no tie to the line; the table's version as the tag of `spec`;
- a scheduled check of the cells by a deadline;
- the release file as a separate task T75 — the recommendation of the plan; the types later, with a second reader in code, as R85 for `deployment.json` — the recommendation of the plan;
- the table in `format/`: there is one normative part with its own version there (R85); the table in YAML: code reads it; vectors of answers by the real table: each correction of a cell would change the vectors;
- `platform` from the recommendation of Т-20: it is not a term of the glossary.

— *Found:*
- the check of the terms of 2026-11-03: the quotes about age and minors of Google, OpenAI and Anthropic did not change. The terms of the Gemini API moved to [aistudio.google.com/docs/terms](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/terms) and show no date of update, and both pages of Google Cloud say "Last modified October 30, 2026";
- privacy 5.3 lacked two paragraphs that stood on the pages before too. At Anthropic, "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Mythos 5" — "These models require 30-day data retention and are not available under ZDR unless expressly authorized by Anthropic" ([API and data retention](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/api-and-data-retention)). At OpenAI, a model may lose an approved zero data retention: "we reserve the right to make models ineligible for Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring for specific customers if reasonably necessary to investigate or prevent severe risk activity, as notified in advance to the impacted customers in writing" ([Your data](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data)). Both pages were read 2026-11-03. So the fact of retention holds for each model on the list of admitted ones (privacy 5.3; П-3);
- there are no strings of providers in the code of `tutor` (`main` be607e5) — the adapters lie in the packages `claude` and `gpt` —, so the table sets the codes of the providers;
- the glossary had no English names of the individual AI capabilities, and the types generator does not accept a narrowing of a field in the branch `then`: that the own key is never open under facts, the schema says by `not`.

## The contract `app` ↔ `api`

**R97. The contract `app` ↔ `api` is the package `novatrail.api.v1`, one for everything `app` calls at `api`, with one enumeration of causes: a refusal is a Connect error with a standard code and the detail `Refusal`, and an AI call outcome is a field of a successful answer. Its first part is the check of an attempt, the service `AttemptService`: a submission and the verdict, the submission of an essay and "Done", the rung's words and the correct answer words, "explain differently", "Hint", the beginning of a step and showing the solution. A tutor's mark is a kind and a place, without a reference to a phrase, and `app` writes its name. The solution of a task goes to the device as bytes of the format's JSON with its version, and the keys as strings of the format. The clock offset goes only with requests to platform AI, and `app` asks for the rung's words by the number of the wrong answer.** The author's answers of 2026-11-03 in planning T62 (RUN.md) — all eight by the recommendations of the plan. The rest is a proposal of the plan that the author approved. Normative — [the contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 15.
- **The package** — `novatrail.api.v1`, one for T62–T64: the enumeration of causes is one for the whole contract, as in R17 api. T62 writes `cause.proto` — the causes of refusals and outcomes, the refusal, the outcome, the close reasons — and `attempt.proto` with `AttemptService`. The account and the profiles of T63 and the lessons and the beginning of an attempt of T64 go into the same package, as files and methods of their own.
- **The border with `api`** — the contract writes what `app` sees:
  - the messages and the service;
  - the enumeration of causes and the refusal message `Refusal`;
  - the refusals of each method with the Connect code — as comments;
  - what a repeat with the same idempotency key answers.

  The order of the checks, the records of the keys and their term, the reservation of quota, CORS, codecs, interceptors and the program's choice of the place of a mark are the code of `api` (R17 api). The causes and the codes follow the table of causes of architecture 3.9 api, and T62 adds "answer not current" — `CAUSE_NOT_CURRENT`. The enumeration is `Cause`, "cause": the "verdict reason" in the glossary is already `reason` (concepts 15), and it is in the same package too, at an answer slot's verdict, so `Reason` would name two things by one word — a proposal of the plan. The plan named the file `reason.proto`.
- **The requests** — by the table of requests of architecture 3.9 api (T07 api):
  - a submission is `SubmitWork`: handwriting, a tapped choice or both. From a sheet — one PNG crop without `sheet_box`, from a workbook — the crops of the filled boxes with their places;
  - the answer is the verdict of each item and answer slot by the observation as a whole, the read value, the number of wrong answers, and on "correct" the solved task. The matched trap is not in it (R05, R57). An AI call that gave no reading is not a refusal: the answer slots that AI reads are "unchecked", and the answer names the outcome;
  - an essay is `SubmitEssay`, in one request: the submission end, the text read, the feedback's words or their absence, the outcome, and whether the attempt was closed while the submission went (R87). "Done" is `Done`;
  - the rung's words are `GetRungWords`, with the work once more; the correct answer words `GetCorrectAnswerWords`; "explain differently" `ExplainDifferently`, without the work; "Hint" `GetHint`, without the work and without AI; the beginning of a step `BeginStep`; showing the solution `ShowSolution`, as a learning action or an adult action (R82);
  - the own key and its provider — with each request of the owner profile that calls AI (R84).
- **The mark** — `Mark`: the kind — for now only a frame, `MARK_KIND_FRAME`, and the place — an answer slot `AnswerSlotPlace` or a box `CropBox` of the package `novatrail.observation.v1`. The group label will come with Т-31 — as an addition to `v1`.
  - A program places the mark (R03), and it belongs to the words of the answer that brought it: the rung's words are one question, no longer than two sentences (R70).
  - `app` writes the name for a screen reader in the screen's language, from the kind, the number and the place (R10 app).
  - A repeat of the rung's words and the same rung asked for again answer with the words the attempt holds, without marks: `api` does not store the places of marks — a proposal of the plan.
- **The solution and the keys** — `SolvedTask`, when the attempt is closed "correct", by showing the solution or by "Done" (R05):
  - the key — as a string of the format at each answer slot that has one: a predicate and a rubric have no key;
  - the solution — the bytes of the JSON of the format's value `solution`, with `module_format_version` beside it;
  - for a task with a rubric — also the texts of the criteria, without the marks of the assessment (the second 2026-11-02 amendment to R05).
- **The clock offset** — `clock_offset_minutes`, `optional`, only in requests to platform AI, for the day of the quota: with the own key there is none (privacy 9, П-23).
- **The rung's words** name the number of wrong answers from the answer to the submission they are about. If it is no longer current, `api` refuses with "answer not current", with the current number in the data. "Explain differently" names it the same way, so as not to spend the right on a rung the learner has not seen — a proposal of the review.
- **"Explain differently" without a reservation of quota** makes no call of platform AI (R11 api): for it the quota, the platform's limit and "not admitted" are refusals, and the right to "differently" stays. For the other requests that call AI, these are outcomes in a successful answer.
- **Showing the solution** — as a learning action with the right `can_learn` or as an adult action with the right `can_manage`, and a request without the right gets `permission_denied`: the PIN is a barrier of the interface (R04 api). "Ladder not passed" — at either kind of action.
- **The mark of an empty box** — in the element's types: a mark with an answer slot of a workbook outlines the box and its strokes, and an empty box — the box alone. This is a correction of R39 canvas.
- **The element's types** — `Marks`, `Mark` and `Anchor` in `@altnovatrail/spec/canvas`, in the form of the temporary types of `canvas`, and the property `marks`. `tools/types/canvas.check.ts` turns a mark of the contract into a mark of the element by a full `switch`, so a kind or a place that the contract adds without a type at the element breaks `tsc` (R83).

— *Why:*
- one task — the author's answer by the recommendation: without vectors and code of checks it is as large as T58, and the package, the causes and the marks are shared by the submission and the words;
- one package — the author's answer by the recommendation: one enumeration of causes for the whole contract is held by R17 api, and a package per task means more versions to keep in step;
- a mark without a phrase — the author's answer by the recommendation: the rung's words are one question (R70), a program places the mark, not `tutor` (R03), and architecture 3.8 app already writes that a mark belongs to the tutor's question. A reference to a phrase can be added as a field;
- the solution as bytes of the format's JSON — the author's answer by the recommendation, as `api` advised for open views (R18 api): a protobuf schema of its own beside the format's schemas is a second schema of one value (R45);
- the offset only to platform AI — the author's answer by the recommendation of the row В36 `api` (a): only the day of the quota needs the offset, and with the own key there is no quota, and minimization does not allow a superfluous field (privacy 1);
- the number of the wrong answer — the author's answer by the recommendation: the server does not store the crop and cannot match it, and without the number the words would describe the earlier work after a new submission, for example from another device;
- the frame of an empty box — the author's answer by the recommendation: without a frame the mark would be only for a screen reader, and the eye would not see it;
- the border by what `app` sees — the author's answer by the recommendation: without the refusal and the repeat in the contract, `app` would have nothing by which to show a refusal (at table 1 of RUN.md this is already rejected).

— *Rejected:*
- two tasks — T62 «отправка и вердикт» and T76 «слова и пометки»;
- a package per task; `novatrail.learning.v1` — the account and the profiles of T63 cannot be called "learning";
- a mark's reference to a phrase — the recommendation (a) of the row В36 `app`: `tutor` would split the words into phrases, and `api` would link them with the places that the program sets;
- protobuf messages of its own for the solution — R18 api;
- the offset with each request that calls AI, as in R11 and architecture 3.9 api;
- the rung's words by the attempt's ID alone, as in architecture 3.9 api;
- an empty box without a frame, as in R39 canvas;
- the contract as only the messages and the causes, with the codes, the refusals and the repeat in the documents of `api`.

— *Found:*
- architecture 3.9 api (`main` 916b2d5) writes «Пока нет. Я прочитал 6», and the third 2026-11-02 amendment to R05 — «Прочитано: 6». "Done" there has neither the criteria nor the solution, while the second 2026-11-02 amendment to R05 gives them to the device. The contract follows `spec`;
- "key not for this profile" is a refusal at `api`, and an outcome at `app`: the contract takes the refusal, since the action did not take place (T07 api);
- the rung's words in architecture 3.9 api have no refusals: the contract names "attempt closed", "no rung", "no more words" — from the fourth wrong answer there is no new rung — and "answer not current";
- the element refuses a task with an answer slot `zone` (R36), so an answer slot on a sheet needs no frame of its own yet: the plan proposed to outline it by the zone, and that waits for zones;
- there were no services in `contracts/` before T62: with `AttemptService` came the first code of `protoc-gen-connect-go`, and `connectrpc.com/connect/v2` became a direct dependency of `contracts/go.mod`.

— *Consequence:*
- `contracts/novatrail/api/v1/` — `cause.proto`, `attempt.proto` and buf's code; [the contracts text](../contracts/README.md) — the opening, sections 1, 5 and 7 and the new section 15;
- `types/canvas/index.d.ts`, `tools/types/canvas.check.ts`, the recipe `types-check` and `tools/types/typescript.mjs`, the README of the npm package;
- the 2026-11-03 amendments to R53, the second to R74 and the sixth to R83;
- concepts 8 and 15; privacy 4 and 9 — П-23; architecture 3.2, 3.5 and 4.1; repositories 8 — Т-31;
- RUN.md — T62, Д50, Д99 and Д100: `api`, `app` and `canvas` get the answer with their move to a tag.

— R03, R04, R05, R09, R36, R52, R53, R54, R57, R67, R68, R69, R70, R74, R75, R82, R83, R84, R86, R87; R04, R09, R10, R11, R14, R15, R17, R18 and R19 api; R08 and R10 app; R26 and R39 canvas; privacy 4, 9; Т-25, Т-31, Т-37.

**R98. The account and the profiles in the contract `app` ↔ `api` are the service `AccountService` of the package `novatrail.api.v1`: the account and the list of its profiles, by which `app` erases on the device what was deleted on another; the owner profile and the child's profile — in two steps, after consent; the PIN of the section for adults; voicing from the task screen; the own key check and its providers; deletion and export. The ID token goes in `Authorization`, and what `app` does on each refusal of a request with a token, the contract writes.** The author's answers 2026-11-03 in the planning of T63 (RUN.md): three — by the recommendations of the plan, and the scope — with children's profiles, not by the recommendation. The rest is a proposal of the plan, which the author approved. Normatively — [contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 15.
- **The scope** is a slice with children's profiles: sign-in, the account, the owner profile and the child's profile, the list of profiles, voicing, the PIN, the own key check and the list of its providers, deletion and export.
  - In epic E4: how consent is given, confirmed and withdrawn and how to remove a waiting one; the yearly refinement of the category and the date the age was stated; a change of country; the quota for the section for adults.
  - The tariff will come as a field of the account, when the tariffs are decided (О-14).
- **The child's profile — in two steps**, as in architecture 3.1 api:
  - `RequestChildConsent` — the age in years, from 0 to 17, and the country. `api` computes the category and records consent "waiting" — with the category and the country, without the pseudonym —, and does not store the age (privacy 3.3);
  - `CreateChildProfile` — by the ID of the consent, when it is confirmed, and while it is waiting — `CAUSE_NO_CONSENT`.

  There is no confirmation in E3, so until E4 there will be no child's profile. The category from 13 to 18 `api` computes by the age of digital consent in the country, and the table of these ages is E4: the contract carries only the age and the country.
- **The owner profile** is a method of its own, `CreateOwnerProfile`: the category `adult` by the owner's statement, without an age, — a proposal of the plan.
- **The account** — `GetAccount`: the ID of the account in `api`, not the UID of the sign-in service; whether the PIN is set; the profiles; the consents that have no profile yet. `CreateAccount` — the invite code and the owner's statement that they are 18 or older.
  - By the list of profiles, `app` erases the databases of the profiles that are not in it — only by a response that has arrived, and for an account from the device's register: a network failure erases nothing (В8 `app`; R04 app).
  - The open attempt and the open lesson runs of a profile will be added by T64.
- **The fields of a profile** (privacy 4): the pseudonym; the avatar — the code of a picture from the set of `app`; the category; the country; the presentation style — so far only voicing; the default solving mode; the interface language — a BCP 47 tag (R92); the grade from 1 to 12 (R49); for a child — "ask before showing"; and the mark of the owner profile.
  - There are no interests, until the format gives a design of the task by interests (concepts 13; R51).
  - The date the age was stated and the last activity stay in `api`.
- **A change** — `ProfileSettings`: a field sent changes, the others stay, and an empty interface language and avatar and grade 0 erase the field. Whether voicing is on is a field of its own, separate from the speed, and an age in the request without a value gets `invalid_argument`. The defaults of a new profile are set by `api`. This is a proposal of the plan. Voicing is also written by `SetVoicing` from the learner's session, with the right `can_learn` (В18 `app`).
- **Sign-in** — the ID token of the sign-in service in `Authorization` (R03 api). What `app` does on each refusal of a request with a token is written by the comment of the service and the [contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 15, — by option (a) of the row В29 `api`:
  - it reads the cause before refreshing the token;
  - `unauthenticated` without a cause — refresh the token and repeat the request;
  - "fresh sign-in needed" — `unauthenticated` with the allowed age of the sign-in;
  - "account gone" — erase everything of the account and sign out, without refreshing the token;
  - "no access" with the account in the device's register — the sign-in of another account (RUN.md, Д89).
- **The PIN** — from 4 to 6 digits: `SetPin`, `VerifyPin`, `ChangePin` and `ResetPin` by a fresh sign-in (R04 api).
  - The response to a check is `PinCheck`: whether the PIN matched, how many attempts are left and, if this attempt closed the entry, when it will open (В37 `app`).
  - A closed entry is the refusal `CAUSE_PIN_LOCKED` with the time when it will open.
- **The own key check** — `CheckOwnKey`: the key is accepted, wrong, the key has no rights, or the provider is closed for the profile (R84). A provider that did not answer is the outcome `CAUSE_AI_FAILURE`; this is a proposal of the plan. `ListOwnKeyProviders` — the providers by the admission function (Т-20; R96).
- **Deletion and export** — by T08 api (В29 `api`; R20 and R21 api): the response "deleted", the refusal "fresh sign-in needed", and repeats — by state. The export is the bytes of the part of `api` in the export format with its version: `app` puts them in the file without reading them, and the format is E4 (R09). This is a proposal of the plan.
- **Legal texts** — the rule of R92 is written in the contracts text: the language goes as a field of the request. The method will come with the texts themselves, their versions and consent, in E4 (the 2026-11-03 amendment to R92).
- **Causes** — ten new values of `Cause`. Eight are by the table of causes of architecture 3.9 api: "no access", "account gone", "fresh sign-in needed", "code not accepted", "country not accepted", "no consent", "PIN locked" and "PIN already set". Two more are a proposal of the plan: "already exists", `CAUSE_ALREADY_EXISTS` with the code `already_exists`, — on creating what already exists; "PIN not set", `CAUSE_NO_PIN`. The data of a refusal are when the PIN entry will open and the allowed age of the sign-in.
- **The idempotency key** — for the request for consent and for the four requests of the PIN: without it a lost response and a repeat would give a second consent, and for the PIN — an incorrect attempt that never happened, and the refusal "PIN already set" on one's own PIN. The other requests of the service repeat by state, and "create an account" checks whether the account exists before the code, so its repeat gets "already exists", not "code not accepted". This is a proposal of the plan, and the keys of the PIN and the order of "create an account" are proposals of the review.
- **Rights** — a method over a profile names its own, `can_manage` or `can_learn`, and a method over the account itself — the PIN, creating a profile, export and deletion of the account — requires only the token's account: this is an adult action, and the PIN before it is a barrier of the interface (R04 api).
- **The idempotency level** of the service's methods is the default. `GetAccount` can delete an account whose user was deleted past `api` (R20 api), and Connect GET with a token gives nothing. This is a proposal of the plan.
- **CORS** — the contract text holds only what `app` sees: which headers the request carries, and that `api` on its origin answers on all paths and responses and exposes `Retry-After`. The lifetime of the response to a preflight request and the origin in the configuration are `api`'s (R18 api; the boundary of R97).

— *Why:*
- children's profiles now — the author's answer; the plan advised leaving the child's profile wholly to epic E4;
- two steps — the author's answer by the recommendation: so `api` decided (architecture 3.1 api), and the child's pseudonym does not go to the server before consent (privacy 1);
- the method of legal texts in E4 — the author's answer by the recommendation (the 2026-11-03 amendment to R92);
- without interests — the author's answer by the recommendation: a field that nobody reads, minimization does not allow (privacy 1) — like the record "givens and unknown", which table 1 of RUN.md has already rejected;
- a change by the fields sent: replacing the profile as a whole would overwrite voicing that the learner changed on another device, and values that the build does not know.

— *Rejected:*
- a slice without children, where the child's profile is wholly in E4 — the recommendation of the plan;
- a minimum for erasing — sign-in, the list of profiles, "account gone" and deletion —, with the PIN, the key and export written by other tasks;
- the child's profile at once, and learning after consent: the server would store the child's pseudonym before consent, contrary to architecture 3.1 api;
- the method of legal texts now;
- interests as a list of codes now: there is no dictionary of codes, and nobody to read them;
- one "create a profile" for the owner and the child, as in architecture 3.9 api: the child's inputs are the age and consent, the owner's — a statement;
- replacing the profile as a whole on a change; `google.protobuf.FieldMask` — in JSON its paths go in lowerCamelCase, and R83 keeps the names of proto;
- the tariff in the response about the account now, as in architecture 3.9 api: there are no tariffs yet (О-14);
- a separate method "is the sign-in fresh" — option (c) of the row В29 `api`: `app` has `authTime` anyway;
- the version of `api` in each response — table 1 of RUN.md has already rejected this (R83).

**R99. The path from a module to a task in the contract `app` ↔ `api` is four services of the package `novatrail.api.v1`: `PackageService` — the open views of the manifest, of the skill graph with tiers, of the technique catalog and of the solving steps by the package digest, without a token, and the request about withdrawal; `ModuleService` — the catalog and the connected modules; `LearningService` — the engine choice, the beginning and the open attempt, and lessons by lesson runs; `ProgressService` — the skill map and the adult's progress. An open view is the bytes of the format's JSON with the format version beside them. The response that closes an attempt says what comes next, and a trap repeats when two closed attempts of the profile have found it.** The author's answers 2026-11-04 in the planning of T64 (RUN.md): three — by the recommendations of the plan, and the scope — not by the recommendation. The rest is a proposal of the plan, which the author approved. Normatively — [contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 15.
- **The scope** is everything in T64: both the adult's progress and the state of skills for the map — by the fields that `Read` of `learner-model` gives, before T01 `skill-map`. What the map needs beyond this will come as a field.
- **The open view** — `OpenView`: the bytes of the format's JSON and beside them `module_format_version`, like the solution of a task in R97. `app` and `api` read it by the types `open` (R72, R73), and by the version `app` decides whether it will read the view, or offers to reload (R44).
- **By the digest, without a token** — `PackageService`: `GetManifest`, `GetSkillGraph` — with the tiers `skill_tiers` —, `GetTechniques` and `GetSolvingSteps`, with the level `NO_SIDE_EFFECTS`, Connect GET without headers, by any package that the image of `api` gives (the 2026-11-04 amendment to R62). The refusals are "the image does not give the version" and "digest unknown", while a deployment goes on; for a part that the module does not have — a response without a view.
- **The files of the device part** — HTTP GET at the address of `api`, the path `/packages/sha256-<hex>/device/<path>`, without a token and headers: `200`, `404`, `410` and `503` with `Retry-After`. `sha256-<hex>` is as the name of the package's archive in the release of `modules` (R03 modules), and the path is as in the device part of a package as files ([format text](../format/README.md), section 25). This is a proposal of the plan.
- **Withdrawal** — `CheckPackages`: `app` names the digests it holds, from the account and without the ID of a profile, and for each gets "gives", "no longer gives" or "unknown". It asks at start and after the refusal "the image does not give the version" or the response `410` (the 2026-11-04 amendment to R63).
- **Modules** — `ModuleService`, with the right `can_learn`, as in architecture 3.9 api:
  - the catalog — the modules whose current version suits the profile by audience (the 2026-11-04 amendment to R63);
  - connecting and disconnecting — without a version;
  - the connected modules — with the digest of the current version, and for a module without one — without a digest.

  The title and the explanation language before the first attempt `app` takes from the open view of the manifest by this digest (R92), and a module without a current version it names by the title from the manifest of the previous version, if it has it, otherwise by the ID. This is a proposal of the plan.
- **The engine choice** — `EngineChoice`: the ID of the choice and what it gives — a lesson or a task; or "nothing to give" with the outcome — the quota, the platform's limit or "not admitted", when the AI that checks the tasks is closed to the learner (R11 api). A choice is given by "something else", `ChooseNext`, by the response that closed an attempt outside a lesson, and by the end of a lesson run on request. The choice itself begins nothing (R13 api).
- **The reason code of the choice** is a field and a list in T65. Whether the code goes into the response to the learner or only into the adult's progress is also decided by T65: a child is not told the code (concepts 12), and a field that nobody reads, minimization does not allow (privacy 1). This is a proposal of the plan.
- **An attempt** — `BeginAttempt`: by the choice of a task, by a segment of a lesson run, or "again" — the same task outside a lesson, on the current version; with the provider of the own key, without the key (R84). The response is the ID of the attempt, the open view of the task and the package digest, and the seed does not go out (R59). `GetOpenAttempt` gives the open attempt on another device too. The choice of a task begins one attempt, and a second request by it gets "already exists", `CAUSE_ALREADY_EXISTS`, — as the choice of a lesson opens one lesson run. The provider at the beginning decides only the checks of the beginning, and each next request goes by its own key, which it carries, — these are proposals of the review.
- **What comes next** — the field `next` in the responses of `SubmitWork`, `ShowSolution` and `Done`, which close an attempt: in a lesson — the place of the next segment or "no more segments", outside a lesson — the engine choice (R13 api).
- **Lessons:**
  - `OpenLesson` — by a choice, `GetLessonRun` — by the ID of the lesson run, `CompleteLesson` — "lesson passed";
  - the response is `LessonRun`: the ID of the lesson run, the open view of the lesson, the package digest, the places of the task segments that have ended and the open attempt of a segment;
  - the run end reasons — `RunEndReason`: passed, unchecked, not suitable, abandoned. "Early" will come as a value with the detailing of `engine`;
  - a choice opens one lesson run, and only a new choice begins a new one. This is a proposal of the plan.
- **The profile** — the open attempt and the open lesson runs, `open_attempt` and `open_lesson_runs`: so a device without their state finds the lesson and the attempt (R98).
- **The skill map** — `GetSkillMap`, as a learning action with `can_learn` or an adult action with the right `can_view`, as in architecture 3.9 api, — by two kinds of action, like showing the solution (R97):
  - the state of the skills of the current version, as `Read` of `learner-model` reads it: the number of evidence and the time of the last practice, the estimate with uncertainty and retention, the mastery band, the cautious probability and the review date;
  - the state of the anchor skills: knows, does not know or unknown, with the cause and the skills that teach it (R07 learner-model).

  There are no traps on the map: the catalog is closed (R57).
- **Progress** — `GetProgress`, with the right `can_view`, by pages:
  - attempts from new to old — the task, the version, the lesson, the close reason, the incorrect answers, the time, and for a task with a rubric — the marks of the criteria (R87);
  - repeating traps — on the first page — found in two closed attempts of the profile or more, by the full ID, with `description` and `trap_advice` of the catalog of the version of the last of them, the number of attempts and the time of the last one. Attempts on a version withdrawn as `wrong_key` do not count toward traps — this is a proposal of the plan, and the first page is a proposal of the review.
- **Causes** — seven new values of `Cause`, by the table of causes of architecture 3.9 api: "the image does not give the version", "digest unknown", "no current version", "not suitable", "lesson run ended", "segments not ended" and "segment unavailable". The data of a refusal are the end of the lesson run with a choice and the places of the segments that have ended.
- **There is no clock offset** at "begin an attempt" and "something else": they do not call the AI (R97), and `api` keeps the family day on the account (privacy 4).

— *Why:*
- everything in T64 — the author's answer; the plan advised the state of skills for the map as a separate task after T01 `skill-map`, since a field in `v1` cannot be removed later;
- the bytes of JSON — the author's answer by the recommendation: so `api` advised (R18 api), and so the solution of a task already goes out (R97);
- two closed attempts — the author's answer by the recommendation: the traps of the first batch have no `skills` (R07 modules), and the model will not count them by skill, and the rule in the contract text tells `app` what the word by which it captions the list means;
- the catalog by audience — the author's answer by the recommendation: the profile has no languages of the learner (R98), and the card names the explanation language precisely for a module in another language (R92);
- tiers with the graph: tiers are a property of the package, not of the learner, and by the digest they are cached together with the graph. So `api` writes too, that `app` takes the graph and the tiers by the digest of the current version;
- the reason code in T65: the form of the code — a closed list or a code with parameters — is its decision, and a field before it would prejudge it. A field can be added to `v1`, but not removed;
- one lesson run per choice: the engine chooses a lesson or a task (R13 api), and an old choice would not begin a new lesson run past it.

— *Rejected:*

- the canonical text of RFC 8785 instead of JSON — this property has no consumer; protobuf messages of its own — a second schema beside the format's schemas (R45; R18 api); `google.protobuf.Struct` — without types, and numbers are `double` (R18 api);

- the reason code in the choice now, as in the row В15 `app` and in architecture 3.9 api.

**R100. The reason code of the engine choice is a closed list `ReasonCode` of eight values, without parameters, by the branches of the rule that concepts 12 names; `spec` wrote it down without T03 `engine`. Only an adult sees the code — in progress, at an attempt —, and it does not go into the response to the learner.** The author's answers 2026-11-04 in the planning of T65 (RUN.md): all four — by the recommendations of the plan. The rest is a proposal of the plan, which the author approved. Normatively — [contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 15.
- **Without T03 `engine`** — `spec` wrote the list itself, as T32 wrote the generator without T02 `module-kit` (the 2026-10-27 amendment to R27): T03 `engine` has not begun, nor have the tasks before it (`engine`, `main` 08bc48a, read 2026-11-04). It narrows to checking the branches of its rule against the list, and a code that is not in it, it asks for with a row «в реестр spec» (the 2026-11-04 amendment to R29).
- **A closed list without parameters** — the enumeration `ReasonCode` in `cause.proto`, beside the engine choice. What was given — the task, the lesson, the version — already lies in the record of progress beside the code.
- **Eight codes:**
  - `REASON_CODE_CONSOLIDATION` — consolidation: after an error — one more task on the same skill, while it is within reach;
  - `REASON_CODE_NEW_SKILL` — a new skill: it has not been issued yet, and its prerequisites are mastered or there are none;
  - `REASON_CODE_QUEUE` — the queue: of the skills within reach, not mastered, that have already been issued — the one that has not been issued for the longest;
  - `REASON_CODE_REPETITION` — repetition: the review date of a mastered skill has come;
  - `REASON_CODE_PROBE` — a probe: a postponed skill came back as a check;
  - `REASON_CODE_SKILL_CHOSEN` — the learner chose the skill on the skill map, and the engine chose the lesson or task on it;
  - `REASON_CODE_AUTHOR_ORDER` — the author's order: a skill with a rubric or without assessment goes next by the skill graph, without the learner model (concepts 4);
  - `REASON_CODE_OPEN_RUN` — the lesson of an open lesson run: the learner continues it.

  The code says why something was given, and `ChoiceKind` says what. A choice has one code — of the branch of the rule that made it, for a lesson the same as for a task; a skill chosen by the learner on the map is always `REASON_CODE_SKILL_CHOSEN`, and the lesson of an open lesson run is always `REASON_CODE_OPEN_RUN`, whatever else would fit them. This is a proposal of the review. "Nothing to give" and an attempt that the learner began "again" have no code. This is a proposal of the plan.
- **Only the adult's progress** — the field `reason_code` of `AttemptRecord`: for an attempt outside a lesson — the code of the choice of its task, for an attempt of a segment — the code of the choice that began the lesson run, as with `chosen_at`. So `REASON_CODE_OPEN_RUN` never occurs in progress: `api` stores it with the choice and exports it (R06 api). In `EngineChoice` and in the other responses to learning requests there is no code. The code of the beginning choice for an attempt of a segment is a proposal of the plan.
- **The words** for the adult are written by `app`, in the languages of its interface (R92; R10 app), and a code that its build does not know it names with words that hold no reason. `api` sends no text of the code. This is a proposal of the plan.
- **A change of the engine's rule** (architecture 4.6): a stored code is history, it is not rewritten, and the meaning of a value does not change ([contracts text](../contracts/README.md), section 2). A new branch of the rule comes as a new value, by a row «в реестр spec» of `engine`; the value of a branch that the engine removed stays, and its comment says that it is no longer given. Consolidation in a lesson, if the detailing of `engine` introduces it, will come the same way, and "early" — as a run end reason (R99). This is a proposal of the plan.
- **The type of the code in Go** at `engine` — its own or from the module of the contracts — is decided by T04 `engine`, and the names and the meaning of the values are taken from `ReasonCode`.

— *Why:*
- without T03 — the author's answer by the recommendation: the codes are awaited by the code of `api` and `app` (rows 6.5 and 6.6 of [COORDINATION.md](../COORDINATION.md)) and by the measurement of `sim`, and in `v1` a value is only added, so a new branch of `engine` will take its place in the list without breakage;

- only progress — the author's answer by the recommendation: a child is not told the code (concepts 12), and a field that nobody on the learner's screen reads, minimization does not allow (privacy 1). The enumeration lies in `cause.proto`, beside the choice: if the choice needs the field too, the enumeration will not have to be moved between files (the ninth 2026-11-04 amendment to R83);
- eight codes — the author's answer by the recommendation: each branch of the rule that concepts 12 already names has a code of its own, and the other branches are the decision of the detailing of `engine`.

— *Rejected:*

## Format 0.3

**R101. Format 0.3 comes out in one task, in the line `spec` 0.9. The rules of version comparison are the [format text](../format/README.md), section 27, with the prefix `module-version.`, and the vectors `vectors/versions/`: a published version in them is a module's folder, and a version of the previous format version is a package as files. The parts of the rows «Выбор» are as `module-kit` proposed; a band after the last and the grades of a band are a minor change; an entry of `retired_skills` in 0.3 only expands. The vectors at the boundary of the steps of a predicate and of a solver were given by a measurement on the pinned version of go.starlark.net.** The author's answers 2026-11-04 in the planning of T69 (RUN.md): all seven — by the recommendations of the plan. The rest is a proposal of the plan, which the author approved. Normatively — [format text](../format/README.md), sections 2, 3, 7, 9, 11, 12, 15, 23, 24, 26 and 27.
- **One task.** By rule 11 of RUN.md the author was asked: T69 is more than one check — a new section with a table and eight rules, a second implementation of the comparison, 152 vectors of comparison and the move of the examples and vectors to 0.3.
- **The line 0.9** — the 2026-11-04 amendment to R44: the line 0.8 was opened by T61 (R96).
- **The prefix** is `module-version.`: the rules refuse a new version, not a module, and they have vectors of their own, like the rules of the index ([format text](../format/README.md), section 7). Eight rules — `above`, `step`, `retired-complete`, `retired-kept`, `retired-known`, `ids-kept`, `languages-kept` and `bands-kept`: the seven that `module-kit` proposed (R13 module-kit), and the rule of bands (the 2026-11-02 amendment to R89).
- **The vectors of comparison** — `vectors/versions/<case>/`: `module/` is the new version, `published/<X.Y.Z>/` — each published one, and `version.yaml`, by the schema `version-vector.schema.json`, — the `version_part` found or the `refusal`. A published version of the same format version is a module's folder: the reader builds its package, and what changed is seen in the YAML. A version of the previous format version is the files of its package that every version keeps, `inventory.json` and `server.json`; the package was built by the reader of 0.2. The reader of 0.3 will not read a module folder of 0.2, and these files it reads by the places that every version keeps: a later version may change the canonical text and the device part. That there is no `device.json` in the vector is a proposal of the review.
- **The table of parts** — by the fields of the schemas of 0.3, by the table of architecture 3.5 module-kit (`main` 19c33aa). The rows «Выбор» are as `module-kit` proposed, with two changes for 0.3: a band removed, renamed, moved or inserted before the earlier ones is refused by `module-version.bands-kept`, and the refinement of `languages.target`, `es` → `es-419`, by `module-version.languages-kept`.
- **Bands:** a band after the last is minor, the grades of a band are minor. Everything earlier is in its place, and only the starting band of a new learner changes: the module "leads otherwise".
- **`retired_skills`** in 0.3 only expands. A wrong entry could be corrected by loosening `module-version.retired-kept` — by a minor version of the format: the modules of 0.3 would stay valid ([format text](../format/README.md), section 2).
- **The boundaries of steps** — a measurement in the session's folder on go.starlark.net `v0.0.0-20261021141710-4f4267fb140d`, in the format's dialect: the predicate through `EvalExprOptions`, the solver through `ExecFileOptions` and `Call`. The harness did not get into the repository.
  - The predicate `value in [n * n for n in range(99997)]` takes 999,990 steps at any value: for 49 — `correct`. With `range(99998)` the count reaches 1,000,000, and the evaluation stops: `unchecked` at any value. These are the verdict vectors `predicate/steps-below-the-limit` and `predicate/steps-reach-the-limit`.
  - A solver with a loop of 9,999,996 turns on one instance takes 99,999,990 steps — 10 at the top level and 99,999,980 for the call —, and with 9,999,997 turns it reaches 100,000,000. These are the template vector `within-the-budget` and the vector `task.template-solver/reaches-the-budget`.
  - A check against the measurement of R11 module-kit: a simple predicate is 20 steps. The call of `solve` of the vector `past-the-budget-of-the-template` with 2,000,000 turns is 20,000,020 steps, and the count reaches the budget on the fifth of 64 instances.

  To reach the limit, a predicate needs a list comprehension, and the rule `task.predicate-expression` did not name its variable. So the [format text](../format/README.md), section 15, now lets in the names that the expression binds itself.
- **The proposals of the plan** that the author approved together with it:
  - a new entry of `retired_skills` is a major change, even when the skill is already absent from the newest version: this is a hole in the history before `diff`;
  - `module-version.step` is checked only for a version that passed `module-version.above`, and a change that a rule refuses gives no part of its own: so a case of refusal breaks one rule;
  - "not changed" — the newest published version with the same package digest: the part `none`, and there is no comparison. The same version with another digest is the refusal `module-version.above`, not `module-index.one-package`, as `module-kit` proposed: the rule of the index refuses the build of the index;
  - proposals of the review: `replaced_by` is a set, and its order changes nothing; the text gives the part of a move of the format only while the format is v0, and `format-check` does not count it further; the files of the package of the previous format version are only those that every version keeps;
  - the text pins down what the second implementation counts:
    - items, answer slots and segments of a lesson are compared by place, and a task segment also by the ID of the task;
    - solving steps — by the number and the pairs "what it gives, as a set, — exit condition";
    - age categories and `digit_height` — in the form in force;

## The `sim` simulator

**R103. The gate of `sim` is `sim`'s answer to Т-16: a library's CI takes `sim` by its tag and the SHA of its commit, in a job of its own, and writes `go.work` on the fly without committing it — `sim`, the pull request's code and the other library at the commit from `sim`'s gate file. The CI gate of `modules` is everything the simulator reads from a package, with invariants and absolute thresholds, without bands. The first version of each library is the baseline before the first tag of `sim`, and the gate holds every change after it. The simulator reads packages by the types of the canonical view, without `module-kit`, and virtual learners are gathered into populations, not into profiles.** The author's answers of 2026-11-07 to the rows «в реестр spec» `sim` В1–В4 (RUN.md `sim`, `main` 9da58bc) and `learner-model` В24 (RUN.md `learner-model`, `main` 98ba29f) — the inbox triage by rule 13 of RUN.md, all by the rows' recommendations. In detail — R03–R05 sim and architecture 2 and 3 sim.
- **The libraries' gate** (В3 `sim`): the gate's job runs on every pull request and every commit of `main` of `learner-model` and `engine`, on `ubuntu-24.04`, with `timeout-minutes: 15`, in the `toolchain` stage of the devcontainer of `sim` of the same tag, and holds the merge. `go.work` is not committed, and the simulator's `go.mod` is not edited.
- **The order of releases** (В3 `sim`): a change that breaks the simulator's API or moves the numbers is first written into `sim` at the commit of its pull request; a tag of `sim` comes out; the library's pull request raises the tag and is merged; after the library's release `sim` raises its `go.mod`. The pair "the threshold 'mastered' and the corridor's target" (the 2026-11-02 amendment to R23) and a change of `learner-model` that breaks the API of `engine` go in one tag of `sim`: the gate file names both commits, `learner-model` is merged when the pull request of `engine` has passed review, and `api` moves to both versions together. A release of `sim` comes out by itself after green CI on `main`, and the callers' sessions raise the tag in them.
- **The gate of `modules`** (В3 `sim`; В5 `modules`): the CI of `modules` runs `sim` when what the simulator reads from a package has changed — `sim` decides this with its command "has it changed" — on the pull request's package, with invariants and absolute thresholds, without bands. A move of the format goes without the simulator, and a pull request that changes the tag of `sim` runs all the graphs.
- **The first version** (В24 `learner-model`; В4 `sim`): the first version of `learner-model` and `engine` is checked by their own tests — the model's also by the property "the appended equals the recomputed" and by standalone's test vectors — and released signed. `sim` sets up the simulator on it and writes the criterion before the first candidate, the first change after it (R163 standalone). The first tag of `sim` comes out after the first versions of both libraries. So row 4.6 of [COORDINATION.md](../COORDINATION.md) is split: the first version — after the moves and the detailing, the changes through the gate — after the first tag of `sim`.
- **The simulator's data** (В4 `sim`): the gate's bands lie in `sim`, in the gate file, which names the commits of `learner-model` and `engine`, the release of `modules` — by its tag and the digest of the index — and the packages by their digests. Synthetic packages `sim` keeps only for its own code and tests, not for judging candidates.
- **Without `module-kit`** (В1 `sim`): `sim` reads `server.json` by the types `formatv0.CanonicalView` of `spec`'s Go module, as R62 and the card architecture 3.9 say, and the window of format versions by the field `module_format_version` of the manifest in the canonical view (R44). "Through `module-kit`" for `sim` in Д59 and Д107 of RUN.md is an error of those rows: there `api` and `tutor` have modules and packages through `module-kit`, and `sim` got into the same phrase with them.
- **Populations** (В2 `sim`): virtual learners are gathered into populations, like standalone's "base population", not into profiles: in the vocabulary a profile is a learner in an account (concepts 15; R26), and a virtual learner has a profile in this sense too — the modules and the runs, the inputs of `engine`. The vocabulary gets "virtual learner" and "population".

— *Why:*
- `go.work` on every pull request keeps the repositories separate (R10), and each change passes the simulator and is not merged if it worsens the criterion (repositories 4); the modules' files are not edited meanwhile;
- the gate of `modules` is everything the simulator reads from a package, not just the graph: a pull request that reweighs tasks without touching the graph would otherwise pass by the simulator (Т-16, added 2026-11-02). Without bands, since the pull request's package has no base to compare them with;
- the first version before the gate: without a version of the model the simulator has nothing to import, and the criterion of R163 standalone is written before the first run of a candidate, not before the first line of code. As it was, item 4 of [COORDINATION.md](../COORDINATION.md) would stand in a circle: the libraries' code waited for the first tag of `sim`, and the first tag needs their first versions;
- one term means one thing (RULES.md, The bar).

— *Rejected:*
- a gate only on release candidates — it would let a worsening into `main`; the three libraries in one repository — against R10; `go mod edit -replace` in CI — it edits the simulator's `go.mod` and gives the same as `go.work`;
- a copy of standalone's model in `sim` as the baseline — the model would live in two repositories, and the simulator would measure `learner-model` by someone else's code; the model's code after the first tag of `sim`, as it was — a circle;
- `sim` through `module-kit` — it would have to amend R62 and card 3.9, and in the build depend on `module-kit` too;
- "profiles of virtual learners" as a second meaning of the word in the vocabulary.

— *Consequence:*
- Т-16 is closed (repositories 8); repositories 1 and 4 — `go.work` with the other library, the gate of `modules`, the first version and the order of releases;
- the card architecture 3.9 — "everything is decided (R03–R05 sim)", the gate's data, the release and the first tag; card 3.10 — the gate of `sim` in the CI of `modules`; card 3.8 — the first version before the gate;
- concepts 15 — "virtual learner" and "population";
- Д59 and Д107 of RUN.md — the part about `sim` is amended; Д111 — what `learner-model`, `engine`, `sim` and `modules` take;
- row 4.6 of [COORDINATION.md](../COORDINATION.md) is split: the first version of `learner-model` stays row 4.6, the first version of `engine` is row 4.7, the changes of both through the gate are row 4.8; the rows `sim` В1–В4 and `learner-model` В24 are in table 5 of RUN.md.
